name: Summon Venomous Snake Swarm
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [see text];; Level: bard 3, cleric 3, druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, witch 3

Components: V, S, M/DF (a square of red cloth)

Casting Time: 1 round

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target(s): One snake swarm

Duration: Concentration +2 rounds

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: no

This spell functions like summon swarm, but can only be used to summon a venomous snake swarm.
